cohort: 180 pregnant women; 90 with SLE and 90 healthy controls
finding: Pregnant women with SLE had altered platelet parameters, increased inflammatory markers, and a higher risk of cesarean section, SGA, stillbirth, and lower birth weight compared to healthy pregnant women.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher in the SLE patient group compared to the control group.
birth_weight: Lower birth weight in the SLE group (p = 0.001)
